question: Given, x + (1)/(x) = 5, then determine the value of frac{2x} {(x²-1)}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given, x + 1/x = 5

We know the identity, x − 1/x = √((x + 1/x)² − 4) = √(5² − 4) = √21

Divide the numerator and denominator of the given expression 2x / (x² − 1) by x to get 2 / (x − 1/x)

Substitute the value to get 2 / √21 = 2√21 / 21

**∴ The correct answer is 2√21 / 21.**
